facts.fact: DCD (20 Feb 2023) quotes Onix saying customers at its Dakar facility can connect to all submarine cables in Senegal: ACE, MainOne and 2Africa (three named); landing stations not given apart from the 2Africa station.
Onix, quoted by DCD, says its neutral colocation facility at the 2Africa landing station in Dakar lets customers connect to all submarine cables in Senegal in a wholesale environment.

systems.owner: Sonatel/Orange landing station (built with Main One 2018/2019)
